scope: Independent binary triage and uncertainty business unit proof; complete-toolbox acceptance remains separate

cold.prompt: Triage both supplied Windows-format binaries without executing them. Establish their static file/machine properties and strongest compiler/runtime evidence, then choose a useful next analysis route for each. Explain uncertainty around packer/obfuscation signatures and avoid inferring runtime process bitness from a PE machine header alone. Retain the actual classifier evidence, concise useful findings and a verified checkpoint. Use the connected toolbox where useful.
